tEn: The Bad Guy With An AI Named Claude
tZh: 名为 Claude 的 AI 背后的坏人
sEn: AI now lets relatively unsophisticated actors run sophisticated operations, but the real-world threat is less alarming than headlines suggest.
sZh: AI 让能力平平的行为者也能实施复杂行动，但现实威胁远没有标题渲染得那么可怕。
absEn: This article examines Anthropic's threat intelligence report on malicious uses of its Claude AI model, covering espionage, cyberattacks, influence operations, surveillance, weapons development, and dual-use biological research. The core argument is that AI now enables relatively unsophisticated actors to conduct sophisticated operations, since AI converts those who are bad at their jobs into effective operators, making the human skill deficit less relevant. The report details cases including Russian and Chinese espionage, financially motivated hackers, hacktivists, and state-linked influence campaigns, while noting that many influence operations remain ineffective and that mass surveillance is fundamentally unsolvable given open models. The author concludes that the biological weapons cases were overstated by the media and represent a success story, and that overall the threat landscape, while real, is less alarming than headlines suggest.
absZh: 本文审视了 Anthropic 关于其 Claude AI 模型被恶意使用的威胁情报报告，内容涵盖间谍活动、网络攻击、影响力行动、监控、武器研发以及两用生物研究。核心论点是：AI 如今使相对并不老练的行为者也能开展复杂行动，因为 AI 能把那些本职工作做得糟糕的人变成高效的操作者，从而让人力技能上的欠缺变得不那么重要。报告详述的案例包括俄罗斯和中国的间谍活动、以经济利益为动机的黑客、黑客活动分子以及与政府有关联的影响力行动，同时指出许多影响力行动仍然收效甚微，并且在开放模型的前提下，大规模监控从根本上无法解决。作者得出结论：生物武器相关案例被媒体夸大了，实际上是一个成功案例；总体而言，威胁态势虽然真实存在，但并没有新闻标题所暗示的那样令人惊慌。

contrib.en: AI turns unsophisticated, low-skill actors into effective operators, reducing the relevance of human skill deficits.
contrib.zh: AI 将不熟练、低技能的行为者变成高效操作者，降低了人类技能不足的相关性。

contrib.en: Sophisticated attacks no longer require sophisticated attackers; AI automates cyber operations, phishing, and agent swarms.
contrib.zh: 复杂攻击不再需要复杂的攻击者；AI 自动化网络行动、钓鱼与智能体集群。

contrib.en: Anthropic documents illicit distillation by Chinese labs using fraudulent accounts and chain-of-thought extraction.
contrib.zh: Anthropic 记录了中方实验室利用欺诈账户与思维链提取进行非法蒸馏。

contrib.en: Influence operations grow larger but often fail to reach genuine audiences, so far more boogeyman than influential.
contrib.zh: 影响力行动规模扩大但常难触及真实受众，目前更像纸老虎而非真正有影响力。

contrib.en: Mass surveillance is fundamentally unsolvable given open models; Claude offers little advantage over alternatives.
contrib.zh: 鉴于开放模型的存在，大规模监控从根本上无法解决；Claude 相对替代方案优势有限。

contrib.en: Biological weapons cases were overstated by media and represent a success story, not major AI uplift.
contrib.zh: 生物武器案例被媒体夸大，实为成功案例，而非 AI 的重大能力提升。

limits.en: Findings rely on Anthropic's own detection and enforcement; independent verification is impossible.
limits.zh: 结论依赖 Anthropic 自身的检测与执法，无法独立验证。

limits.en: Report covers only Claude misuse, not open models or other frontier systems, limiting generalizability.
limits.zh: 报告仅覆盖 Claude 的滥用，未涉及开放模型或其他前沿系统，泛化性有限。

limits.en: Detection may miss undetected operations, and banned actors can simply create new accounts.
limits.zh: 检测可能遗漏未被发现的操作，被封禁者也可轻易注册新账户。

limits.en: Publishing the report may be a strategic deterrent, raising questions about commercial and political motives.
limits.zh: 发布报告或为战略威慑，引发对其商业与政治动机的质疑。

limits.en: China interprets the report and distillation advisory as hostile, potentially harming AI safety cooperation.
limits.zh: 中国将报告与蒸馏警告视为敌对，可能损害 AI 安全合作。

full.sec: How To Not Tell a Fable

paras.en: The classifiers are hella annoying sometimes, but Anthropic says they work.
paras.zh: 这些分类器有时非常烦人，但 Anthropic 表示它们确实有效。

paras.en: In all cases, Claude Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus models were used; no malicious activity was found on Claude Fable or Mythos (which has a series of safeguards in place that greatly reduce its ability to perform harmful cyber tasks).
paras.zh: 在所有案例中，使用的都是 Claude Haiku、Sonnet 和 Opus 模型；在 Claude Fable 或 Mythos 上未发现任何恶意活动（Mythos 部署了一系列防护措施，大幅降低了其执行有害网络任务的能力）。

paras.en: The one exception was an attempted distillation attack on Fable by Zhipu, but there were enhanced safeguards in place and Zhipu switched to going after Opus.
paras.zh: 唯一的例外是智谱（Zhipu）对 Fable 发起的一次蒸馏攻击尝试，但由于当时已部署了增强的防护措施，智谱转而将目标转向了 Opus。

full.sec: Bad Dudes Tend To Be Relatively Unsophisticated
full.secZh: 坏家伙往往相对不 sophisticated

paras.en: If Bad Dudes were more often sophisticated and Good At Job, the world would look very different.
paras.zh: 如果坏家伙往往更 sophisticated 且擅长工作，世界会大不相同。

paras.en: Luckily, Bad Dudes are usually unsophisticated and Bad At Job.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，坏家伙通常不 sophisticated 且不擅长工作。

paras.en: (Everyone else is mostly similar, but less so and less reliably.)
paras.zh: （其他人大多类似，但程度较轻且不太可靠。）

paras.en: AI, for both better and worse, turns Bad At Job into Good At Job, making it less relevant that the humans are Bad At Job via doing the things. Here are Anthropic’s big themes:
paras.zh: AI，无论好坏，将不擅长工作转变为擅长工作，使得人类通过做事而不擅长工作变得不那么相关。以下是 Anthropic 的重要主题：

paras.en: 1. Sophisticated attacks no longer require sophisticated attackers.
paras.zh: 1. 复杂的攻击不再需要复杂的攻击者。

paras.en: 2. AI's role in cyber operations has become increasingly autonomous.
paras.zh: 2. AI 在网络行动中的角色已变得越来越自主。

paras.en: 3. The AI supply chain as target, loot, and attack compute.
paras.zh: 3. AI 供应链作为目标、战利品与攻击算力。

paras.en: 1. As in, attackers go after sources of compute, and use that to keep going.
paras.zh: 1. 也就是说，攻击者会盯上算力来源，并利用这些算力维持行动。

paras.en: 2. To use Claude as a Bad Dude, you need the value of the loot and compute, and you also need the cover of newly compromised accounts, to stay ahead of Anthropic cracking down.
paras.zh: 2. 要把 Claude 当作“坏人”来用，你需要战利品和算力的价值，还需要新近被攻陷账户的掩护，以便在 Anthropic 打击之前保持领先。

paras.en: 3. Basically everyone in the report is stealing their access, at minimum via getting around regional restrictions and buying endless subsidized subscriptions, on top of then doing Bad Dude things with the compute.
paras.zh: 3. 基本上，报告中的每个人都在窃取访问权限，至少是通过绕过地区限制、购买无穷无尽的补贴订阅，然后在此基础上用算力干“坏人”的事。

paras.en: 1. Like everything else, diffusion takes time.
paras.zh: 1. 与其他一切事物一样，扩散需要时间。

paras.en: You need fewer less sophisticated humans, who are less Good at Job, to Do Thing.
paras.zh: 你需要更少的不那么高明的人，他们不那么擅长完成工作，来做事。

paras.en: For most things, that's great. This report is about the exceptions.
paras.zh: 对大多数事情来说，这很好。本报告关注的是例外情况。

paras.en: You especially need less in order to adapt when someone defends against you, and to develop new methods.
paras.zh: 你尤其需要更少（的高明者），以便在有人对你进行防御时做出适应，并开发新方法。

paras.en: GTG-20006 is a Russian espionage operation linked to Midnight Blizzard. They had a standard set of cyber attack tools. They used AI to monitor how well their tools evaded detection, and iterated until security defenses did not detect their malware, then launched AI-automated attacks, including AI phishing operations from AI-registered domains.
paras.zh: GTG-20006 是一个与 Midnight Blizzard 相关联的俄罗斯间谍行动。他们拥有一套标准的网络攻击工具。他们利用 AI 监测其工具规避检测的效果，并反复迭代，直到安全防御系统无法检测到其恶意软件，随后发动 AI 自动化攻击，包括从 AI 注册的域名发起 AI 钓鱼行动。

paras.en: Targets varied, including Ukrainian government, military and diplomatic staff, various government agencies and defense-industrial companies linked to Ukraine, and Ukraine's drone supply chain. They took over WhatsApp accounts via headless browsers and targeted surveillance cameras. All of it was automated.
paras.zh: 攻击目标多种多样，包括乌克兰政府、军事与外交人员、与乌克兰相关的多个政府机构和国防工业公司，以及乌克兰的无人机供应链。他们通过无头浏览器接管 WhatsApp 账户，并针对监控摄像头。这一切都是自动化的。

paras.en: GTG-50014 were smash-and-grab opportunists associated with the ShinyHunters collective. They are doing the standard opportunistic things, but AI let them scale and cast a wide net looking for vulnerable systems, targeting bulk data theft and potential extortion. The whole thing is basically 'vibe hacking,' with 'living off the land,' having the AI look around and use whatever it finds, seeking any vulnerability at all, rather than having a plan.
paras.zh: GTG-50014 是与 ShinyHunters 团伙有关联的砸抢式机会主义者。他们在做标准的机会主义行为，但 AI 让他们得以扩大规模并广撒网寻找存在漏洞的系统，目标是批量数据窃取和潜在勒索。整件事基本上就是“氛围黑客”（vibe hacking），采用“就地取材”（living off the land）的方式，让 AI 四处探查并利用其发现的一切，寻找任何漏洞，而非事先制定计划。

paras.en: GTG-10007 was a Chinese-speaking espionage operation, likely in Changsha in China's Hunan province. Claude was used to automate workflows and form agent swarms, the same as any other coding task, except here it was vulnerability research, testing and exploit design. Roughly fifty organizations were targeted, and an education-technology company was compromised.
paras.zh: GTG-10007 是一个中文间谍行动，很可能位于中国湖南省长沙市。Claude 被用于自动化工作流并组建智能体集群，与其他任何编码任务一样，只不过这里的任务是漏洞研究、测试和漏洞利用设计。约有五十个组织成为目标，一家教育科技公司被攻陷。

paras.en: GTG-50020 is a Russian-speaking, financially-motivated actor, historically targeting hotel booking and financial technology platforms, that pivoted to attack the AI industry and steal API keys via prompt injecting sandboxes. They attacked 30 companies, but they never achieved their objective, which was access to a pre-release Claude model.
paras.zh: GTG-50020 是一个讲俄语、以经济利益为动机的行为者，历史上针对酒店预订和金融科技平台，后来转向攻击 AI 行业，并通过提示注入沙箱窃取 API 密钥。他们攻击了 30 家公司，但从未实现其目标，即获取一个预发布版本的 Claude 模型。

paras.en: GTG-50029 was a French-speaking hacktivist who targeted European political and affiliated entities, an example of uplift for unsophisticated threat actors, who then managed to compromise 14 of 42 WordPress sites including via an undocumented race condition and steal users’ political opinions, a mass attack on privacy.
paras.zh: GTG-50029 是一名法语黑客活动分子，其攻击目标为欧洲政治实体及附属机构；这是能力较低的攻击者获得能力提升的一个案例——他们随后成功入侵了 42 个 WordPress 站点中的 14 个，其中还利用了一个未公开的竞争条件（race condition），并窃取用户的政治观点，构成了一次对隐私的大规模攻击。

paras.en: Influence operations are getting larger and more sophisticated.
paras.zh: 影响力行动正变得规模更大、手段更复杂。

paras.en: We've seen groups of actors use Claude to build networks of fake social media profiles and entire news sites, leveraging these platforms to publish deceptive content, while completely concealing the entities behind these operations.
paras.zh: 我们已看到一些行为体团体利用 Claude 搭建虚假社交媒体资料网络乃至完整的新闻网站，借助这些平台发布欺骗性内容，同时完全隐藏这些行动背后的实体。

paras.en: It is remarkable how well social media has held up so far in the age of AI. Threat actors spin up hundreds of accounts on a regular basis, all providing social proof for each other, and we complain but the defenders are mostly winning.
paras.zh: 令人瞩目的是，在 AI 时代，社交媒体迄今表现得相当稳健。威胁行为体经常批量创建数百个账号，彼此提供社会认同；我们虽有抱怨，但防御方大体上占据上风。

paras.en: This report details nine of those cases. They originated in Russia, Iran, Turkey, and across the Gulf, South Asia, Africa and Europe, and targeted audiences on six
paras.zh: 本报告详述了其中九起案例。这些案例源自俄罗斯、伊朗、土耳其，以及

paras.en: Influence operations are getting larger and more sophisticated.
paras.zh: 海湾地区、南亚、非洲和欧洲各地，并针对六个

paras.en: Building such campaigns builds a signature that Anthropic often detects. When Anthropic finds an operation in the planning stage, or discovers one afterwards, they ban the accounts and use this to strengthen their detection mechanisms. But of course such actors can always get new accounts and try again.
paras.zh: 构建此类行动会留下特征痕迹，Anthropic 常常能够检测到。当 Anthropic 在策划阶段发现某项行动，或在事后发现时，他们会封禁相关账号，并借此强化其检测机制。但当然，这类行为者总能获取新账号并再次尝试。

paras.en: 3. AI helped to build the apparatus as well as the content.
paras.zh: 3. AI 既帮助构建了内容，也帮助构建了运作机制。

paras.en: 5. Laundering of attribution, sourcing and certainty.
paras.zh: 5. 对归属、来源与确定性的洗白。

paras.en: 7. Fake personas (and impersonation of real personas).
paras.zh: 7. 虚假人设（以及对真实人物的冒充）。

paras.en: 8. Targeting people and accountability mechanisms.
paras.zh: 8. 针对个人与问责机制。

paras.en: 9. Influence operations often fail to reach a genuine audience.
paras.zh: 9. 影响力行动往往无法触及真实受众。

paras.en: The final takeaway is what I see from the outside. These campaigns are often remarkably ineffective, individually and in general, and much more boogeymen so far than actually influential. Hopefully that will last.
paras.zh: 最终结论是我从外部观察到的。这些行动往往效果甚微，无论是个别还是整体而言，迄今为止更像是吓唬人的鬼故事，而非真正具有影响力。希望这种情况能持续下去。

paras.en: These operations mostly (but not entirely) target third world areas, where there is less competition, that is less sophisticated, in the media and influence ecosystems.
paras.zh: 这些行动主要（但不完全）针对第三世界地区，那里的媒体和影响力生态系统竞争较少、也不那么复杂。

paras.en: 1. GTG-04001: Russian manipulation in the Central African Republic, via a heavily biased AI-generated news pipeline.
paras.zh: 1. GTG-04001：俄罗斯在中非共和国的操纵行动，通过一个带有严重偏见的 AI 生成新闻管道进行。

paras.en: 2. GTG-54002: Commercial ‘influence-as-a-service’ spanning six continents, traced to France. They used 70 fabricated news sites and 250 inauthentic Twitter accounts. Used Claude to write and rewrite news articles and tailor them.
paras.zh: 2. GTG-54002：商业性的“影响力即服务”跨越六大洲，源头可追溯至法国。他们使用了 70 个伪造新闻网站和 250 个不真实的 Twitter 账户。利用 Claude 撰写和重写新闻文章并进行定制。

paras.en: 3. GTG-84005: An election-manipulation platform targeting Malaysia. About 1,000 fake Twitter accounts, a fake news outlet and a series of fabricated dossiers, as paid political influence-as-a-service.
paras.zh: 3. GTG-84005：一个针对马来西亚的选举操纵平台。约 1,000 个虚假 Twitter 账号、一家假新闻媒体以及一系列伪造档案，以付费的“政治影响力即服务”形式运作。

paras.en: 4. GTG-24015: Russian state-media editorial pipelines for editorial and news production for audiences in various countries. They targeted the elections in Moldova.
paras.zh: 4. GTG-24015：俄罗斯官方媒体的编辑流水线，面向多个国家的受众进行评论与新闻生产。他们针对的是摩尔多瓦的选举。

paras.en: 5. GTG-34001: Iranian state-aligned ICCO, Islamic Propaganda Office and Bina Observatory. They were laying the foundation for an explanatory jihad.
paras.zh: 5. GTG-34001：与伊朗国家立场一致的 ICCO、伊斯兰宣传办公室和 Bina 观察站。他们正在为一场“解释性圣战”奠定基础。

paras.en: 6. GTG-54006: Automated pro-Awami League self-described fake-news operation targeting rural Bangladesh.
paras.zh: 6. GTG-54006：一个自动化的、亲人民联盟（Awami League）的所谓假新闻行动，针对孟加拉国农村地区。

paras.en: 7. GTG-84006: MEK/NCRI-aligned influence operation using AI to impersonate an activist and recruit inside Iran. They scraped posts on Telegram to try and assemble a profile of the particular activist.
paras.zh: 7. GTG-84006：与 MEK/NCRI 立场一致的影响力行动，利用 AI 冒充一名活动人士并在伊朗境内招募人员。他们抓取了 Telegram 上的帖子，试图拼凑出该特定活动人士的画像。

paras.en: 8. GTG-54004: A domestic inauthentic behavior campaign in Kenya, basically astroturfing public sentiment.
paras.zh: 8. GTG-54004：一场发生在肯尼亚的国内虚假行为（inauthentic behavior）行动，基本上是在对公众情绪进行人造草根式（astroturfing）操纵。

paras.en: 9. GTG-84002: A UAE-directed influence operation targeting the Muslim Brotherhood, the Sudan conflict, and UN accountability mechanisms. This was supposed to be 'a coordinated transatlantic and regional operation to dismantle the Muslim Brotherhood globally.'
paras.zh: 9. GTG-84002：一场由阿联酋主导的影响力行动，目标是穆斯林兄弟会、苏丹冲突以及联合国问责机制。该行动本应是一场“跨大西洋与区域协同行动，以在全球范围内瓦解穆斯林兄弟会”。

paras.en: Overall, I was not impressed. It does not seem like such folks are getting much done, at least not via Claude. There's a thin line between a lot of this and ordinary politics. If this is as bad as it gets, then this is very good news.
paras.zh: 总体而言，我并未感到印象深刻。看起来这些人并没有取得多少成果，至少没有通过 Claude 取得多少成果。这其中许多行为与普通政治之间的界限十分模糊。如果最坏也就到这个程度，那反而是个非常好的消息。

paras.en: These cases include threat actors from China, Iran, and West Africa, as well as the commercial "surveillance-for-hire" market, and range from operations carried out by a single individual to entire teams.
paras.zh: 这些案例涉及来自中国、伊朗和西非的威胁行为者，以及商业性的“监控雇佣”市场，范围从单人实施的行动到整个团队的行动。

paras.en: And they did it in violation of the Terms of Service. How dare they.
paras.zh: 而且他们是在违反服务条款的情况下这样做的。真是胆大包天。

paras.en: In many cases this was 'analyze a ton of social media posts,' including by the state to target dissidents and dissident groups, or groups likely to cause trouble. Most of the groups were Chinese or Iranian. In one case the Iranians targeted Jews. Sometimes malware was involved.
paras.zh: 在许多案例中，这属于“分析海量社交媒体帖子”，包括由国家针对异见人士和异见团体，或可能制造麻烦的团体。大多数目标团体是中国人或伊朗人。在一个案例中，伊朗人针对的是犹太人。有时还涉及恶意软件。

paras.en: Are Iran and China the only places trying to do this level of AI surveillance? Or are they the only ones crazy enough to use Claude?
paras.zh: 伊朗和中国是仅有的试图进行这种级别 AI 监控的地方吗？还是说，他们是仅有的疯狂到敢用 Claude 的人？

paras.en: Anthropic highlights GTG-50027, a single independent consultant in Bamako, who used Claude as part of Mali's state intelligence service (ANSE) to target roughly 25 million SIM cards. This one was not really disrupted. Further work was prevented, but the system had already been deployed and it remains deployed.
paras.zh: Anthropic 重点提到了 GTG-50027，一名驻巴马科的独立顾问，他将 Claude 作为马里国家情报局（ANSE）的一部分，用于锁定约 2500 万张 SIM 卡。这一案例实际上并未被真正阻断。后续工作被阻止了，但该系统早已部署，且目前仍处于部署状态。

paras.en: This is fundamentally not a solvable problem. Anthropic and other AI companies are in the business of selling intelligence, and there are also open models providing intelligence. There is no way to fully stop all forms of mass surveillance, domestically or otherwise, given the alternative options. Claude does not provide that big an advantage here over open models. If some people are out there to analyze public information, you can slow them down but they are going to succeed.
paras.zh: 这从根本上不是一个可解决的问题。Anthropic 和其他 AI 公司从事的是出售智能的业务，同时也有提供智能的开源模型。鉴于存在替代选项，无论是在国内还是其他地方，都无法完全阻止各种形式的大规模监控。Claude 在这方面相比开源模型并没有提供那么大的优势。如果有些人要分析公开信息，你可以拖慢他们的速度，但他们最终会成功。

paras.en: Another operation stood out: GTG-30005, due to its target:
paras.zh: 另一次行动因其目标而引人注目：GTG-30005。

paras.en: In another investigation, we identified and disrupted an Iran-nexus threat actor that used Claude to collect and analyze publicly accessible data to develop targeting recommendations against US naval forces in the region.
paras.zh: 在另一项调查中，我们识别并阻止了一个与伊朗有关联的威胁行为者，该行为者使用 Claude 收集和分析公开可访问的数据，以制定针对该地区美国海军部队的目标建议。

paras.en: That goes hand in hand with the next section: Use of Claude in conventional weapons.
paras.zh: 这与下一节内容密切相关：Claude 在常规武器中的使用。

paras.en: This is fundamentally not a solvable problem. Anthropic and other AI companies are in the business of selling intelligence, and there are also open models providing intelligence. There is no way to fully stop all forms of mass surveillance, domestically or otherwise, given the alternative options. Claude does not provide that big an advantage here over open models. If some people are out there to analyze public information, you can slow them down but they are going to succeed.
This refers to software for such weapons, as well as targeting and control systems. There are six cases here: three in China, two in Russia and one in Yemen.
paras.zh: 这里指的是此类武器的软件，以及瞄准与控制系统。此处共有六个案例：三个在中国，两个在俄罗斯，一个在也门。

paras.en: First there are the weapon systems development cases:
paras.zh: 首先是武器系统开发案例：

paras.en: 1. GTG-87001: A Yemen-based guided weapons engineering cell using Claude to develop guidance software. Claude as software engineer, except for weapons.
paras.zh: 1. GTG-87001：一个位于也门的制导武器工程小组，使用 Claude 开发制导软件。Claude 充当软件工程师，只不过是为武器服务。

paras.en: 2. GTG-17001: A China-based operation drafting a fire control specification and acquisition documents for undersea warfare, within their defense contractor ecosystem. They pretended to be American to get Claude to write a proposal.
paras.zh: 2. GTG-17001：一个位于中国的行动，在其国防承包商生态体系内，为水下作战起草火控规格书与采购文件。他们假扮成美国人，让 Claude 撰写一份提案。

paras.en: 3. GTG-27005: A Russia-based likely freelance operation to engineer an autonomous military first-person-view kamikaze drone swarm. Again, the wrong software.
paras.zh: 3. GTG-27005：一个位于俄罗斯、很可能是自由职业性质的行动，旨在设计自主军用第一人称视角（FPV）自杀式无人机蜂群。同样，又是用错了地方的软件。

paras.en: 4. GTG-17002: A China-based operation to build targeting software for electronic warfare and air defense suppression.
paras.zh: 4. GTG-17002：一个位于中国的行动，旨在为电子战和防空压制开发瞄准软件。

paras.en: It is a thin line between ordinary software development and software that assists with conventional weapons. It is no surprise developers would attempt to use Claude. Indeed, presumably lots of Western weapons developers also use Claude.
paras.zh: 普通软件开发与辅助常规武器的软件之间界限模糊。开发者尝试使用 Claude 并不奇怪。事实上，想必许多西方武器开发者也在使用 Claude。

paras.en: 1. GTG-27006: Russia-based operation to procure mixed military and civilian goods. Claude was used to buy things. Eventually it added up to obvious military use.
paras.zh: 1. GTG-27006：一个位于俄罗斯的行动，采购军民两用物资。Claude 被用于购买物品。最终累积起来明显用于军事目的。

paras.en: 2. GTG-17003: China-based operation to collect open-source intelligence on directed-energy weapons and their supply chain.
paras.zh: 2. GTG-17003：一个位于中国的行动，收集关于定向能武器及其供应链的开源情报。

paras.en: Again, this happens to be a particular use we do not like, which is Not So Different.
paras.zh: 再次，这恰好是我们不喜欢的一种特定用途，而这“并无不同”。

paras.en: How much is being attempted in practice? They have five cases.
paras.zh: 实践中究竟有多少尝试？他们给出了五个案例。

paras.en: Regional use controls were evaded, but the five case studies here look like scientists. They are doing dual-use things, where it is not clear that harm was intended.
paras.zh: 区域使用管制被规避，但这里的五个案例研究看起来像是科学家所为。他们在做双重用途的事情，其中并不清楚是否有意造成伤害。

paras.en: 1. A grant application for gain-of-function research.
paras.zh: 1. 一份功能获得性研究的资助申请。

paras.en: 2. A research program engineering highly pathogenic mammal-adapted avian influenza.
paras.zh: 2. 一个工程化高致病性哺乳动物适应型禽流感的研究项目。

paras.en: 3. Orthopoxvirus research, including help with related logistics.
paras.zh: 3. 正痘病毒研究，包括协助相关后勤工作。

paras.en: 4. Two cases of dual-use non-transmissible novel venoms and toxins.
paras.zh: 4. 两起两用、非传染性新型毒液与毒素的案例。

paras.en: The first two cases seem like clear cases of Do Not Want, even if the people involved thought they were helping. The other three are less clear. None of the cases were the kind of dangerous use of AI we worry about, where AI provides major uplift. AI was being used because AI is highly useful at ordinary tasks.
paras.zh: 前两起案例看起来显然是“不想要”的情形，即便涉事者自认为是在帮忙。其余三起则不那么明确。这些案例都不属于我们所担忧的那种 AI 被危险使用、即 AI 提供重大能力提升的情形。使用 AI 是因为 AI 在普通任务上极为有用。

paras.en: The New York Times report on this, with the headline 'Anthropic Says It Blocked Possible Efforts To Build Biological Weapons,' seems highly overstated here.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》对此的报道标题为“Anthropic 称其阻止了可能的生物武器制造企图”，这一说法在此处似乎被严重夸大。

paras.en: I call this a huge success story, assuming Anthropic isn't hiding worse things. These aren't even fully Bad Dudes, only misguided ones.
paras.zh: 我认为这是一个巨大的成功案例——前提是 Anthropic 没有隐瞒更糟糕的事情。这些人甚至算不上十足的“坏蛋”，只是被误导了而已。

paras.en: Ah, good to get back to Ordinary Decent Crime. Except, you know, at scale.
paras.zh: 啊，回到普通体面的犯罪真是太好了。只不过，你知道的，是规模化的。

paras.en: They only offer one example, but it’s a fun one.
paras.zh: 他们只提供了一个例子，但挺有趣的。

paras.en: GTG-15001: Fake dating app network. Love it. Now we’re talking. To AIs. A full network of 20 fake dating apps, with more than 4,700 distinct AI personas that talked to over 25,000 unique individuals over two weeks in April, with swipe feeds that were 25% real people and 75% AIs. For some of the 25%, workers were hired to choose among three candidate AI replies, thus proving good game design, and paid per message. Claude ran the AI personas, because nothing but the best will do. I might be mangling the details a bit.
paras.zh: GTG-15001：虚假约会应用网络。喜欢。现在我们来谈谈。对 AI。一个完整的网络，包含 20 个虚假约会应用，超过 4,700 个不同的 AI 角色，在 4 月的两周内与超过 25,000 个独特个体进行了交谈，滑动推送中 25%是真人，75%是 AI。对于其中 25%的，他们雇佣了工人从三个候选 AI 回复中选择，从而证明了良好的游戏设计，并按消息付费。Claude 运行了 AI 角色，因为只有最好的才行。我可能把细节搞乱了一点。

paras.en: Messaging is metered, which is how they make money. That was a hint.
paras.zh: 消息是计费的，这就是他们赚钱的方式。那是一个提示。

paras.en: I mean, yeah, yeah, scam and fraud, poor fake users, very sad.
paras.zh: 我的意思是，是的，是的，诈骗和欺诈，可怜的虚假用户，非常悲伤。

paras.en: The weird part is that this is the best case study, and here the only one. Where are all the others? Again, this is a huge success story.
paras.zh: 奇怪的是，这是最好的案例研究，而且在这里是唯一的一个。其他的都在哪里呢？再次强调，这是一个巨大的成功故事。

paras.en: We define illicit distillation as an industrial-scale, covert campaign to extract a model's capabilities and replicate them in another model without authorization. Illicit distillation is typically enabled by fraud: sophisticated networks of fake accounts created with stolen credit cards, login credentials, and API keys.
paras.zh: 我们将非法蒸馏定义为一种工业规模的隐蔽活动，旨在未经授权地提取模型能力并将其复制到另一个模型中。非法蒸馏通常通过欺诈手段实现：利用窃取的信用卡、登录凭证和 API 密钥创建复杂的虚假账户网络。

paras.en: Other frontier labs have faced distillation attacks. OpenAI has called attention to this activity since early 2025.
paras.zh: 其他前沿实验室也遭遇过蒸馏攻击。OpenAI 自 2025 年初以来一直呼吁关注这一活动。

paras.en: If you want to argue that distillation using your own queries and the model outputs, or data otherwise acquired above board, is fine, I respectfully disagree with you for practical reasons and for the same reasons I support copyright and patent protections, but I understand why you would think that.
paras.zh: 如果你认为使用自己的查询和模型输出，或以其他正当方式获取的数据进行蒸馏是没问题的，那么出于实际原因，以及与我支持版权和专利保护相同的理由，我恭敬地表示不同意，但我理解你为什么会这么想。

paras.en: If you think that it is okay to then use a 'Chain of Thought extractor' as an exploit, as part of that effort, I disagree with you a lot more, and I think you're clearly in the wrong, but I understand why some people think intellectual property is not real and you should be able to just steal it and are willing to cheer for Chinese companies to steal American IP.
paras.zh: 如果你认为在此过程中使用‘思维链提取器’作为漏洞利用手段是可以接受的，那么我更加不同意，并且我认为你显然是错误的，但我理解为什么有些人认为知识产权不是真实的，认为你可以直接窃取它，并愿意为美国公司知识产权被窃取而欢呼。

paras.en: If you think it is okay to do this by secretly rerouting sensitive customer queries to Claude, or using accounts created with stolen credit cards, login credentials and API keys to harvest data?
paras.zh: 如果你认为通过秘密将敏感的客户查询重定向到 Claude，或使用窃取的信用卡、登录凭证和 API 密钥创建的账户来收集数据是没问题的，那么……

paras.en: Then I'm sorry, you're just flat out wrong; that is obviously not okay.
paras.zh: 那么很抱歉，你就是完全错了，这显然是不可接受的。

paras.en: I mention those particular things because that is what is going on.
paras.zh: 我之所以特别提到那些事情，是因为那正是当前正在发生的情况。

paras.en: Over the last several months, unauthorized labs have developed increasingly
paras.zh: 在过去几个月里，未经授权的实验室开发出了越来越

paras.en: sophisticated methods to circumvent our defenses and harvest the capabilities of US frontier models. These labs generally access Anthropic's models by routing requests through proxy services, also known as "transfer stations."
paras.zh: 复杂的方法来绕过我们的防御，并攫取美国前沿模型的能力。这些实验室通常通过代理服务（也称为“中转站”）转发请求，以此访问 Anthropic 的模型。

paras.en: To circumvent our geographic restrictions and related controls, these proxy services create thousands of new accounts using false identities, fake or stolen credit cards, and stolen API keys.
paras.zh: 为了绕过我们的地理限制及相关管控，这些代理服务利用虚假身份、伪造或盗用的信用卡以及窃取的 API 密钥，创建了成千上万个新账户。

paras.en: Unauthorized labs also obtain transcripts of user exchanges with US frontier models by purchasing them from third-party resellers. These resellers include the operators of proxy services, which often save exchanges between users and US models without the knowledge or consent of those users.
paras.zh: 未经授权的实验室还通过从第三方转售商处购买的方式，获取用户与美国前沿模型交互的对话记录。这些转售商包括代理服务的运营者，此类代理服务常常在用户不知情或未经用户同意的情况下，保存用户与美国模型之间的交互内容。

paras.en: Meanwhile, there is an ongoing war where Anthropic tries to block various prompts that attempt to extract the Chain of Thought, and the Chinese and other attackers try to develop new extraction methods.
paras.zh: 与此同时，一场持续进行的攻防战正在上演：Anthropic 试图拦截各种试图提取思维链（Chain of Thought）的提示词，而中国及其他攻击者则试图开发新的提取方法。

paras.en: These findings raise concerns about the misuse of user data by PRC AI labs. DeepSeek, Xiaomi, and Moonshot fed conversations between their own models and users into Claude.
paras.zh: 这些发现引发了对中国 AI 实验室滥用用户数据的担忧。DeepSeek、小米和 Moonshot 将其自身模型与用户之间的对话输入 Claude。

paras.en: These labs then used Claude's responses as training data with which to distill Claude's capabilities. Some of these exchanges included sensitive information, including from individual users, major multinational companies, and state-affiliated actors. Many of these exchanges were relayed from users of third-party model routing services commonly used by users in the United States and Europe. Those sessions contained names, email addresses, company data, and other sensitive data of hundreds of end users in at least a dozen languages. These practices are likely inconsistent with privacy laws and the labs' own terms of service.
paras.zh: 随后，这些实验室将 Claude 的回复用作训练数据，以蒸馏 Claude 的能力。其中部分交互内容包含敏感信息，涉及个人用户、大型跨国公司以及国家附属行为体。许多此类交互内容是从第三方模型路由服务的用户处转发的，而这类服务在美国和欧洲的用户中被普遍使用。这些会话包含数百名最终用户的姓名、电子邮件地址、公司数据及其他敏感数据，涉及至少十余种语言。此类做法很可能违反隐私法律以及这些实验室自身的服务条款。

paras.en: Unauthorized labs also obtain transcripts of user exchanges with US frontier models by purchasing them from third-party resellers. These resellers include the operators of proxy services, which often save exchanges between users and US models without the knowledge or consent of those users.
The report includes the example of asking Claude to analyze CCTV surveillance footage from hundreds of Chinese cameras, and exposing live Russian government credentials. It can get ugly out there.
paras.zh: 报告中的例子包括要求 Claude 分析来自数百个中国摄像头的闭路电视监控录像，并暴露了俄罗斯政府的实时凭证。情况可能会变得很糟糕。

paras.en: Your response can be 'well Anthropic is flat out lying about this' but short of that there is no way to excuse the behaviors in question.
paras.zh: 你的回应可以是‘Anthropic 在这件事上完全在撒谎’，但除此之外，没有任何办法能为这些行为开脱。

paras.en: All of this looks like it is in direct violation of numerous laws, including Chinese laws.
paras.zh: 所有这些似乎都直接违反了众多法律，包括中国法律。

paras.en: In many of these cases, if nothing else, Article 39 of PIPL was definitely broken by DeepSeek, Moonshot and Xiaomi, and likely Criminal Law Art. 235a as well:
paras.zh: 在许多此类案例中，至少 DeepSeek、Moonshot 和小米肯定违反了《个人信息保护法》第 39 条，并且很可能也违反了《刑法》第 235 条之一：

paras.en: Accessible Law (PIPL): Where a personal information processor provides personal information of an individual to a party outside the territory of the People’s Republic of China, it shall inform the individual of such matters as the name of the overseas recipient, contact information, purpose, and method of processing, type of personal information and the way and procedure for the individual to exercise the rights prescribed herein against the overseas recipient, and shall obtain the individual’s separate consent.
paras.zh: 《个人信息保护法》：个人信息处理者向中华人民共和国境外提供个人信息的，应当向个人告知境外接收方的名称、联系方式、处理目的、处理方式、个人信息的种类以及个人向境外接收方行使本法规定权利的方式和程序等事项，并取得个人的单独同意。

paras.en: That's in addition to everyone breaking the Anti-Unfair Competition Law, of using data lawfully held by another business operator through "fraud, coercion, or circumventing or damaging technical or management measures" where this disrupts market competition order. Seems to apply here.
paras.zh: 除此之外，各方还违反了《反不正当竞争法》，即通过“欺诈、胁迫，或规避、破坏技术或管理措施”的方式，使用其他经营者合法持有的数据，从而扰乱市场竞争秩序。这一条似乎适用于本案。

paras.en: Oh, and all of this involved Ordinary Decent Fraud, as in Criminal Law Art. 196 and Art. 177a.
paras.zh: 哦，而且这一切还涉及《刑法》第 196 条和第 177a 条所规定的普通诈骗罪。

paras.en: And then there's the Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services, Article 7.
paras.zh: 此外还有《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》第七条。

paras.en: 1. Alibaba (Qwen) used a massive network of fake accounts.
paras.zh: 1. 阿里巴巴（Qwen）使用了一个庞大的虚假账号网络。

paras.en: 2. Moonshot (Kimi) secretly sent user exchanges to Claude, via a massive network of fake accounts.
paras.zh: 2. 月之暗面（Kimi）通过一个庞大的虚假账号网络，秘密将用户对话发送给 Claude。

paras.en: 3. DeepSeek also secretly sent user exchanges to Claude.
paras.zh: 3. DeepSeek 还秘密将用户对话发送给 Claude。

paras.en: 4. Zhipu (GLM) engaged in the extraction practice, the fake account practice, and also recently targeted the cyber capabilities of leading American models ahead of the release of GLM-5.3.
paras.zh: 4. 智谱（GLM）实施了提取行为、虚假账号行为，并且最近在 GLM-5.3 发布前还针对美国领先模型的网络能力下手。

paras.en: 5. Xiaomi carried out the distillation practice, using saved user requests.
paras.zh: 5. 小米利用保存的用户请求实施了蒸馏行为。

paras.en: 6. SenseTime, MiniMax and others form a third-party reseller ecosystem.
paras.zh: 6. 商汤、MiniMax 等公司构成了第三方转售生态系统。

paras.en: As in, all the cool kids are doing it. That's how they are the Chinese cool kids.
paras.zh: 也就是说，所有“酷小孩”都在这么干。他们就是这样成为中国的“酷小孩”的。

paras.en: How do the Chinese have the best open models?
paras.zh: 中国如何拥有最好的开源模型？

paras.en: GTG-16005: CoT distillation and AI R&D campaign by Alibaba (Qwen / Tongyi Lab).
paras.zh: GTG-16005：阿里巴巴（Qwen / 通义实验室）的思维链蒸馏与 AI 研发活动。

paras.en: Alibaba's CoT distillation pipeline injected a fixed prompt into each request that forced Claude to write out its reasoning traces inside inline text tags before providing its final answer. Those CoT transcripts were then saved and converted into data that could be used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). These SFT transcripts were used to help train Alibaba's Qwen models, and were used to distill Claude's capabilities into Qwen 3.5, 3.6, and 3.7.
paras.zh: 阿里巴巴的思维链蒸馏管道在每个请求中注入一个固定提示，迫使 Claude 在提供最终答案之前，在内联文本标签中写出其推理轨迹。这些思维链记录随后被保存并转换为可用于监督微调（SFT）的数据。这些 SFT 记录被用于帮助训练阿里巴巴的 Qwen 模型，并被用于将 Claude 的能力蒸馏到 Qwen 3.5、3.6 和 3.7 中。

paras.en: Alibaba's illicit distillation campaign peaked at nearly 3 million exchanges per day
paras.zh: 阿里巴巴的非法蒸馏活动峰值达到每天近 300 万次交互

paras.en: launched from more than 3,500 fraudulent accounts.
paras.zh: 从超过 3,500 个欺诈账户发起。

paras.en: … Scale of distillation attacks attributable to Alibaba between May and July 2026: over 151 million exchanges observed.
paras.zh: ……2026 年 5 月至 7 月期间可归因于阿里巴巴的蒸馏攻击规模：观测到超过 1.51 亿次交互。

paras.en: GTG-16002: Moonshot serves Claude instead of Kimi and collects exchanges for model training.
paras.zh: GTG-16002：Moonshot 以 Claude 代替 Kimi 提供服务，并收集交互数据用于模型训练。

paras.en: We discovered that Moonshot AI, the company that produces the Kimi family of models, silently forwarded customer requests to Claude, instead of processing them using Kimi.
paras.zh: 我们发现，生产 Kimi 系列模型的公司 Moonshot AI 将客户请求静默转发给 Claude，而非使用 Kimi 进行处理。

paras.en: Moonshot then displayed Claude's responses to users. These users thought they were using a Kimi model, but received responses from Claude instead.
paras.zh: 随后，Moonshot 将 Claude 的回复展示给用户。这些用户以为自己在使用 Kimi 模型，实际收到的却是 Claude 的回复。

paras.en: … Scale of distillation attacks attributable to Alibaba between May and July 2026: over 151 million exchanges observed.
In one instance, over a ten-day period, Moonshot relayed almost 300,000 customer requests to Anthropic, the vast majority of which were routed to Opus.
paras.zh: 在一个案例中，Moonshot 在十天内向 Anthropic 转发了近 30 万条客户请求，其中绝大多数被路由至 Opus。

paras.en: Moonshot used a proxy service network of 5,380 fraudulent accounts, most of which appeared to be located in Singapore and Japan.
paras.zh: Moonshot 使用了一个由 5,380 个欺诈账户组成的代理服务网络，其中大多数账户似乎位于新加坡和日本。

paras.en: In addition to serving Claude's responses to their customers, Moonshot also captured and saved at least a portion of these exchanges.
paras.zh: 除了向客户提供 Claude 的回复外，Moonshot 还捕获并保存了这些交互中至少一部分内容。

paras.en: … When responding, Claude returns a reference to its raw thinking as a "thinking signature" instead of the raw thinking to mitigate the risk of unauthorized distillation.
paras.zh: ……在回复时，Claude 返回的是指向其原始思考的引用，即“思考签名”（thinking signature），而非原始思考本身，以降低未经授权蒸馏的风险。

paras.en: In one instance, over a ten-day period, Moonshot relayed almost 300,000 customer
… Scale of distillation attacks attributable to Moonshot between May and July 2026: over 23 million exchanges observed.
paras.zh: ……2026 年 5 月至 7 月间归因于 Moonshot 的蒸馏攻击规模：观察到超过 2300 万次交换。

paras.en: Lyman Stone 石來民: Okay so over the course of reading this I shifted from “wow Kimi is awful” to “WHY DID ANTHROPIC SPILL THE BEANS ON THIS INCREDIBLE INTELLIGENCE HACK”
paras.zh: Lyman Stone 石來民：好吧，在阅读这篇文章的过程中，我从“哇，Kimi 真糟糕”转变为“为什么 Anthropic 要泄露这个不可思议的情报黑客手段”

paras.en: No, Lyman. I get why you would say that, but we do not steal user data, even if the user was attempting to use Kimi and kind of deserves it.
paras.zh: 不，Lyman。我理解你为什么会这么说，但我们不会窃取用户数据，即使用户试图使用 Kimi 并且有点活该。

paras.en: GTG-16001: DeepSeek serves Claude instead of its own models and collects exchanges for model training.
paras.zh: GTG-16001：DeepSeek 提供 Claude 而非自家模型，并收集交换数据用于模型训练。

paras.en: Our investigation revealed that DeepSeek also deployed tactics similar to Moonshot’s. DeepSeek built a CoT extraction pipeline, relying on the same cross-session replay attack described above. DeepSeek also silently relayed exchanges to Claude without informing DeepSeek customers. Like GTG-16002, their customers were likely not made aware that their requests were being funneled to Claude.
paras.zh: 我们的调查显示，DeepSeek 也采用了类似 Moonshot 的策略。DeepSeek 构建了一条思维链提取管道，依赖于上述相同的跨会话重放攻击。DeepSeek 还在未告知 DeepSeek 客户的情况下，悄悄将交换数据转发给 Claude。与 GTG-16002 一样，他们的客户很可能并未意识到其请求被引流至 Claude。

paras.en: … Scale of distillation attacks attributable to DeepSeek over 14 days in July 2026: over 12.1 million exchanges observed.
paras.zh: ……2026 年 7 月 14 天内可归因于 DeepSeek 的蒸馏攻击规模：观测到超过 1210 万次交互。

paras.en: GTG-16006: Zhipu distillation, AI R&D and targeting cyber capabilities.
paras.zh: GTG-16006：Zhipu 蒸馏、AI 研发及定向网络攻击能力。

paras.en: Zhipu, branded outside China as Z.ai, ran a chain-of-thought extraction pipeline against Claude, replaying captured Claude reasoning traces back through Claude to clean them for training its GLM models. Over just ten days, Zhipu launched a CoT extraction pipeline against Claude Opus 4.8 by rotating through 273 fraudulent accounts to evade our model restrictions.
paras.zh: Zhipu（在中国境外以 Z.ai 为品牌）针对 Claude 运行了一条思维链提取流水线，将捕获的 Claude 推理轨迹重新回放给 Claude，以清洗这些轨迹，用于训练其 GLM 模型。仅在十天内，Zhipu 就通过轮换 273 个欺诈账户来规避我们的模型限制，对 Claude Opus 4.8 发起了一条 CoT 提取流水线。

paras.en: … Zhipu also used Claude to improve its own post-training pipelines, using Claude to judge model outputs and clean and normalize reasoning transcripts harvested for
paras.zh: ……Zhipu 还利用 Claude 改进其自身的后训练流水线，使用 Claude 评判模型输出，并清洗和规范化为蒸馏而采集的推理记录，

paras.en: distillation.
paras.zh: 用于蒸馏。

paras.en: … More recently, ahead of the release of its GLM 5.3 model, we identified a campaign to target the cyber capabilities of leading US frontier models. Zhipu researchers used public vulnerability datasets to develop various capture-the-flag challenges.
paras.zh: ……更近一些，在其 GLM 5.3 模型发布之前，我们发现了一项针对美国领先前沿模型网络能力的行动。智谱（Zhipu）研究人员利用公开漏洞数据集开发了多种夺旗（capture-the-flag）挑战。

paras.en: Zhipu initially attempted to target the cyber capabilities of Anthropic's Fable model. Fable—Anthropic's top generally accessible model—has strengthened cyber safeguards, making it more difficult for would-be distillers to target Fable's cyber capabilities.
paras.zh: 智谱最初试图针对 Anthropic 的 Fable 模型的网络能力。Fable——Anthropic 最顶级的可公开访问模型——已强化了网络安全防护措施，使潜在的蒸馏者更难针对 Fable 的网络能力。

paras.en: Zhipu eventually gave up trying to target Fable after Anthropic's cyber safeguards degraded Zhipu's attacks.
paras.zh: 在 Anthropic 的网络安全防护措施削弱了智谱的攻击之后，智谱最终放弃了针对 Fable 的尝试。

paras.en: … More recently, ahead of the release of its GLM 5.3 model, we identified a campaign to target the cyber capabilities of leading US frontier models. Zhipu researchers used public vulnerability datasets to develop various capture-the-flag challenges.
Zhipu initially attempted to target the cyber capabilities of Anthropic’s Fable model. Fable—Anthropic’s top generally accessible model—has strengthened cyber
… Scale of distillation attacks attributable to Zhipu over 17 days in June and July 2026: over 3.4 million exchanges observed.
paras.zh: ……2026 年 6 月至 7 月的 17 天内，可归因于智谱（Zhipu）的蒸馏攻击规模：观测到超过 340 万次交互。

paras.en: That's right. They tried to forcibly distill Fable's cyber capabilities in order to put them into an open model. Luckily, this did not work and they had to pivot to Opus 4.6 where the safeguards were weaker.
paras.zh: 没错。他们试图强行蒸馏 Fable 的网络能力，以便将其植入一个开放模型。所幸这一尝试未能成功，他们不得不转向防护措施较弱的 Opus 4.6。

paras.en: GTG-16008: Distillation campaign by Xiaomi
paras.zh: GTG-16008：小米发起的蒸馏行动

paras.en: This one was only ~400k messages, using saved user messages to seed the exchanges.
paras.zh: 这一次仅有约 40 万条消息，利用保存的用户消息来播种这些交互。

paras.en: Our investigation suggests that Xiaomi may have launched its MiMo-V2-Pro model
paras.zh: 我们的调查表明，小米可能已推出其 MiMo-V2-Pro 模型

paras.en: with a free trial period—which was then extended—with the intent to use the surge in international developer use of the model to distill Claude capabilities. The bulk of the distillation attacks on Claude began just as the trial period was ending.
paras.zh: 并设有免费试用期——该试用期随后被延长——其意图是利用该模型在国际开发者中使用量的激增来蒸馏 Claude 的能力。针对 Claude 的大部分蒸馏攻击正是在试用期即将结束时开始的。

full.sec: What You Gonna Do About It, Punk?

paras.en: The arms race continues. If you're wondering why you can't see the CoT, part of it is to guard it against supervision pressure à la _An Alien Mind_, but the main reason is avoiding distillation.
paras.zh: 军备竞赛仍在继续。如果你想知道为什么看不到 CoT，部分原因是为了像《An Alien Mind》那样防范监督压力，但主要原因是避免蒸馏。

paras.en: We use metadata and look for signals of irregular activity to identify accounts
paras.zh: 我们利用元数据并寻找异常活动的信号，以识别与代理服务网络相关联的账户。

paras.en: associated with proxy service networks. Instead of banning proxy accounts
paras.zh: 我们不是逐个封禁代理账户，而是努力将这种可疑活动归因于某个特定组织，

paras.en: individually, we work to attribute this suspicious activity to a specific organization,
paras.zh: 从而使我们能够更有效地采取全面执法行动，以防止

paras.en: allowing us to take comprehensive enforcement actions more effectively to prevent
distillation attacks.
paras.zh: 蒸馏攻击。

paras.en: We’ve also built classifiers designed specifically to detect adversarial extraction.
paras.zh: 我们还构建了专门用于检测对抗性提取的分类器。

paras.en: We’ve also added new safeguards that make it harder for unauthorized labs to distill Claude’s capabilities.
paras.zh: 我们还新增了防护措施，使未经授权的实验室更难蒸馏 Claude 的能力。

paras.en: Claude now summarizes its internal reasoning before responding, which makes stolen transcripts less useful for training another model.
paras.zh: Claude 现在会在回应前先总结其内部推理，这使得窃取的对话记录在训练另一个模型时用处更小。

paras.en: … As we investigate and disrupt distillation attacks, what we learn will continue to inform the safeguards we build.
paras.zh: ……在我们调查并阻断蒸馏攻击的过程中，我们所获得的经验将持续为构建的防护措施提供依据。

paras.en: Google has a clause where if you are attempting to distill Gemini, their plan is to intentionally sabotage the responses, to damage your operation. I believe this is the correct policy. If you have strong evidence the user is doing crime, to try and steal your stuff, as in a giant network of fraudulent accounts being used for distillation, then yes, you should be able to screw with them, not merely ban their accounts.
paras.zh: Google 有一项条款：如果你试图蒸馏 Gemini，他们的计划是故意破坏响应，以损害你的操作。我认为这是正确的政策。如果你有强有力的证据表明用户正在犯罪，试图窃取你的东西，比如一个用于蒸馏的庞大欺诈账户网络，那么是的，你应该能够对他们进行干扰，而不仅仅是封禁他们的账户。

paras.en: I see this as very distinct from the idea of silently degrading responses when users attempt to do AI R&D. That's unacceptable and hostile, either refuse the requests or don't, since this risks hitting normal work and now everyone has to be paranoid about being hit.
paras.zh: 我认为这与在用户尝试进行 AI 研发时悄悄降低响应质量的想法截然不同。那是不可接受且充满敌意的，要么拒绝请求，要么不拒绝，因为这可能波及正常工作，现在每个人都得偏执地担心自己会被针对。

paras.en: Distillation via massive fraudulent account networks and CoT extraction attacks is very obviously different. That is not a trigger you hit by accident, or without mens rea. You know what you did. If you play that game, you deserve whatever you get and more.
paras.zh: 通过大规模欺诈账户网络和思维链提取攻击进行的蒸馏显然不同。那不是你会意外触发的，也不是在没有犯罪意图的情况下触发的。你知道自己做了什么。如果你玩这种游戏，你活该承受一切，甚至更多。

paras.en: Mostly the report is good news. Yes, there are Bad Dudes out there, trying to do various bad things. Occasionally they do something bad. It all adds up to not much. We happily accept this level of malicious use.
paras.zh: 总体而言，这份报告是好消息。是的，外面确实有“坏家伙”在试图做各种坏事。他们偶尔也会得手。但这一切加起来也没多少。我们乐于接受这种程度的恶意使用。

paras.en: The details of many of these operations are pretty wild. This was a short summary.
paras.zh: 其中许多行动的细节相当离奇。以上只是一个简短总结。

paras.en: Of course, there is also this, especially given no mention of North Korea.
paras.zh: 当然，还有这一点，尤其是考虑到报告完全没有提到朝鲜。

paras.en: PoIiMath: "We disrupted every operation in the report"
paras.zh: PoIiMath：“我们瓦解了报告中的每一项行动”

full.sec: A Very Different Read of The Report

paras.en: I read this report as mostly good news, as saying that the situation is basically fine, and also as therefore not big news. There were so many other stories that seemed much bigger that same week.
paras.zh: 我读这份报告时，认为它主要是好消息，它表明情况基本良好，因此也算不上什么大新闻。同一周内，还有许多其他事件看起来比这重要得多。

paras.en: Ryan Fedasiuk does not see it that way. He overstates his case, in that he claims this was front page news everywhere, which it wasn’t. But he sees this, together with the NSA/CISA/FBI advisory on the distillation efforts, as fundamentally altering the US-China relationship and China’s attitude towards Anthropic, and China’s relationship to its top labs.
paras.zh: Ryan Fedasiuk 不这么看。他夸大了自己的观点，声称这是各地头条新闻，但事实并非如此。然而，他认为这件事，连同 NSA/CISA/FBI 关于蒸馏努力的咨询，从根本上改变了美中关系、中国对 Anthropic 的态度，以及中国与其顶级实验室的关系。

paras.en: I do expect a substantial change in PRC’s relationship with its top labs, after revelations that they silently shipped a lot of consumer queries directly to Anthropic, including requests from China’s security services.
paras.zh: 我确实预计，在揭露中国顶级实验室悄悄将大量消费者查询直接发送给 Anthropic（包括来自中国安全部门的请求）之后，中国与这些实验室的关系将发生重大变化。

paras.en: China threatened ‘resolute countermeasures’ in response to the advisory, a day before the full report got issued on the 10th. Then on the 11th Mao Ning at the MFA briefing did respond to the report in particular by saying China opposes attempts to ‘smear China by distorting facts.’
paras.zh: 中国针对该咨询威胁采取‘坚决反制措施’，这是在 10 日完整报告发布的前一天。随后在 11 日，外交部发言人毛宁在记者会上特别回应了该报告，称中国反对‘歪曲事实抹黑中国’的企图。

paras.en: Ryan Fedasiuk: Here is a low-confidence theory: I think we are under-weighting the extent to which Chinese state media's hostility toward U.S.-China coordination on AI security may be a response specifically to Anthropic's AI Misuse report.
paras.zh: Ryan Fedasiuk：这里有一个低置信度的理论：我认为我们低估了中国官方媒体对美中人工智能安全协调的敌意程度，这可能特别针对 Anthropic 的 AI 滥用报告。

paras.en: Anthropic's report is one of the finest intelligence products I've ever seen. Not only does it document a world-historic Chinese counterintelligence failure—but it publicly, personally embarrassed China's security services on the front page of every newspaper in the world.
paras.zh: Anthropic 的这份报告是我见过的最出色的情报产品之一。它不仅记录了一场具有世界历史意义的中国反间谍失败——而且还在全世界每一份报纸的头版上，公开地、针对个人地让中国的安全部门蒙羞。

paras.en: This was a huge, huge deal for China. It will fundamentally alter the relationship between Chinese AI labs and the state. I am still expecting reprisals against the Chinese AI companies that were caught routing sensitive requests directly to Claude, unbeknownst to their Chinese users.
paras.zh: 这对中国来说是一件极其重大的事件。它将从根本上改变中国 AI 实验室与国家之间的关系。我仍然预计，那些被发现在其中国用户不知情的情况下将敏感请求直接路由到 Claude 的中国 AI 公司将遭到报复。

paras.en: In fact, I'm sure this was part of Anthropic's calculation to originally release the report. Embarrassing China's security services and putting a target on the back of Chinese labs engaging in distillation is surely an effective deterrent to that practice.
paras.zh: 事实上，我确信这正是 Anthropic 最初决定发布这份报告的盘算之一。让中国的安全部门蒙羞，并给从事蒸馏的中国实验室背上靶子，无疑是对这种做法的一种有效威慑。

paras.en: But I also think this partly explains what we're seeing with Chinese state media's hostility toward Anthropic and Dario in particular. They view Anthropic not just as the tip of the American AI spear, but as a bad-faith actor gung-ho on smearing and destabilizing China's political system.
paras.zh: 但我也认为，这在一定程度上解释了中国官方媒体对 Anthropic、尤其是对 Dario 的敌意。他们不仅把 Anthropic 视为美国 AI 长矛的矛尖，还将其视为一个热衷于抹黑和破坏中国政治体制的恶意行为者。

paras.en: It would be unfortunate if this personal, political animosity were now bleeding into wider discussions of U.S.-China coordination on AI safety—when, in fact, I do think the Party cares about AI risk, and will continue to care about AI risk (cf MSS Minister Chen Yixin's recent commentary).
paras.zh: 如果这种个人化、政治化的敌意现在渗透到更广泛的美中 AI 安全协调讨论中，那将是不幸的——而事实上，我确实认为党关心 AI 风险，并将继续关心 AI 风险（参见国家安全部部长陈一新近期的评论）。

paras.en: An editorial in China Daily supports the claim that the reactions are linked, although I can only imagine what it would be like to have America represented by looking at an editorial in one newspaper, even if it was, e.g., The New York Times.
paras.zh: 《中国日报》的一篇社论支持了这些反应相互关联的说法，尽管我只能想象，仅凭一份报纸的社论来代表美国会是什么样子，即便这份报纸是例如《纽约时报》。

paras.en: Julian Gewirtz: I haven't seen much attention to this new China Daily editorial today. But it offers a revealing look at Beijing's response to calls for an AI slowdown.
paras.zh: Julian Gewirtz：我今天没有看到太多人关注《中国日报》这篇新社论。但它揭示了北京方面对呼吁放缓 AI 发展的回应。

paras.en: It explicitly connects the calls from @DarioAmodei, @sama, and @elonmusk with Anthropic's recent report alleging illicit distillation by Chinese companies—portraying them as parts of a coordinated effort to protect American firms from Chinese competition.
paras.zh: 它明确将 @DarioAmodei、@sama 和 @elonmusk 的呼吁与 Anthropic 近期指控中国公司非法蒸馏的报告联系起来——将它们描绘成一场协同行动的一部分，目的是保护美国公司免受中国竞争。

paras.en: Sam Altman says Trump and Xi could win the Nobel Peace Prize for an AI agreement: "I don't think this is hard. This is like a one-page document." But that's wrong. Upcoming AI talks will be "hard." And this editorial shows why.
paras.zh: Sam Altman 表示，特朗普和习近平可能因达成一项 AI 协议而获得诺贝尔和平奖：“我不认为这很难。这就像一页纸的文件。”但这是错的。即将到来的 AI 会谈将会“艰难”。而这篇社论说明了原因。

paras.en: The headline really sums it all up: "'Dr Frankenstein' alarm cries of US' AI elites a self-serving bid for profit."
paras.zh: 标题确实概括了一切：“‘弗兰肯斯坦博士’式的美国 AI 精英的警报呼声，是自私自利的逐利之举。”

paras.en: A few key quotes from the China Daily:
paras.zh: 以下是《中国日报》的几段关键引文：

paras.en: –"The [distillation] report, and the corporate 'alliance' that followed it, amounted in essence to a coordinated play — a response to Chinese competition and to the regulatory pressure coming from Washington. Its aims were threefold: to blunt China's AI advance, to win a favorable policy environment at home and to keep investors' enthusiasm for US AI alight."
paras.zh: ——“这份[蒸馏]报告以及紧随其后的企业'联盟'，本质上是一场协同行动——既是对中国竞争的反应，也是对来自华盛顿的监管压力的回应。其目标有三：削弱中国在 AI 领域的进展、在国内争取有利的政策环境，以及维持投资者对美国 AI 的热情。”

paras.en: –"The distinction between a security measure and a competitive moat can become blurred when the companies building the moat are also allowed to define 'illicit distillation.'"
paras.zh: ——“当构筑护城河的公司同时被允许界定何为'非法蒸馏'时，安全措施与竞争护城河之间的界限就可能变得模糊。”

paras.en: –"The proposed coordination [to 'pace the frontier'] among the three companies sounds rather like a club whose membership rules have been drafted before the guest list is announced. A global AI-safety framework that excludes China is not quite global."
paras.zh: ——“三家公司之间拟议的[为'前沿'定速]协调，听起来颇像一个俱乐部——其会员规则在嘉宾名单公布之前就已拟好。一个将中国排除在外的全球 AI 安全框架，算不上真正的全球框架。”

paras.en: The editorial doesn't rule out diplomacy but is trying to set the terms for upcoming talks.
paras.zh: 这篇社论并未排除外交途径，而是试图为即将举行的会谈设定条件。

paras.zh: 关于中国对“Pacing the Frontier”的回应，更多内容[[见此]](https://juliangewirtz.substack.com/p/chinas-ai-reckoning)。

paras.en: Julian's full report says that China is interpreting the call to Pace the Frontier as being primarily about slowing China down. Or at least, that's what they are saying. You would expect them to say that ahead of the Summit no matter their true posture and level of understanding.
paras.zh: Julian 的完整报告指出，中国将“Pacing the Frontier”的呼吁解读为主要意在拖慢中国的发展。或者至少，这是他们公开的说法。无论其真实立场和理解程度如何，在峰会之前你都会预期他们这么说。

paras.en: Anthropic is by far the most China-hostile of the American AI labs, calling for strong action on chips and distillation as core parts of their overall strategic posture. China is highly reasonably interpreting that, plus this kind of report and the full cutting off of all Chinese access to Claude, as being hostile. This could then by association make China less inclined to cooperate on catastrophic or existential risks, as they too are vulnerable to this kind of cognitive mistake.
paras.zh: Anthropic 是迄今为止美国 AI 实验室中对中国最为敌视的一家，其将芯片与蒸馏方面的强硬行动作为整体战略姿态的核心部分加以呼吁。中国将这一点，连同此类报告以及对所有中国用户完全切断 Claude 访问，合理地解读为敌意。这种关联随后可能使中国在灾难性或生存性风险上更不愿合作，因为他们同样容易犯这类认知错误。

paras.en: I would as always caution against the tendency to treat each day's developments as something that permanently alters or solidifies attitudes and relationships and conflicts. Every month looks very different from the previous month. I have lost track of the number of individual moves in the game that I have been told 'inevitably' led to huge permanent changes, without which maybe things would have gone differently. Such claims are almost always wrong.
paras.zh: 我一如既往地提醒，不要动辄把每一天的进展视为会永久改变或固化态度、关系与冲突的事情。每个月看起来都与上个月大不相同。我已经记不清有多少次被告知，棋局中的某一步‘必然’导致了巨大的永久性变化，而没有这一步，事情或许会走向不同。这类说法几乎总是错的。
